AreaLayoutSpec.description: A generated area layout (maps to `adventure_generate_layout`; pass its result to `adventure_apply_layout`).

tileset.description: Tileset resref, e.g. "ttf01" forest, "tdc01" crypt, "ttr01" rural (see `list_tilesets`).

transitionCount.description: Number of exits to generate. Default 1.

transitionDirections.description: Which edges the exits sit on.

width.description: Width in tiles. 9 fits one room, 14 fits several (see `suggest_area_size`).

avenue.description: Reserve the primary room-to-room connectivity spine as a protected avenue BEFORE packing feature groups, so a stamped group never lands on it — and bias a feature placed in an avenue-adjacent room toward a position/rotation whose entrance faces the avenue (best-effort; falls back to the ordinary uniform-random placement if no facing match fits). Default false — every existing caller's output is byte-identical without it. Ignored when `safeMode` is set (no features are packed at all in that mode, so there is nothing to bias).

safeMode.description: "Safe scaffold" mode: disables every variety knob (L-shaped room merges, S-curve corridors, shortcut corridors, obstacle patches, feature-group packing) so the result uses only plain rectangular rooms, straight corridors, and uniform floor/wall zones — the tile classes least likely to hit a solver fallback. Intended for a human to finish by hand in the toolset (add scenery, placeables, and terrain variety themselves) rather than trust the solver for everything. Combine with `rooms: 1` and a small width/height (see MIN_SINGLE_ROOM_AREA_SIZE) for a minimal-footprint scaffold the user can expand outward manually.

seed.description: Seed for the layout's randomness: the same seed, tileset, size and style give the same layout (default: a fresh seed, returned in the result).
